sourceObligations: Construct actual localized algebraic automorphic modules on the appropriate unitary group and CM/totally real field; supply the weight lattice, actual level subgroups and arithmetic finite double cosets.
Use small-level stabilizer triviality to derive freeness of the level-V module over the finite level-quotient group algebra and identify trace coinvariants, as in CHT Lemma 3.3.1.
Construct the local Hecke projection defining the BLGG auxiliary summand, prove its nonzero freeness and specialization, and derive a common rank bound from specialization.
Identify the actual diamond-action quotient and its scalar map with the deformation-side characters, including the polarized/CM deformation comparison and required local crystalline components.

Match the number of auxiliary character directions. BLGG uses the maximal l-power quotient of its (n-1,1)-parabolic level quotient. The current rational full-torus family has Fin degree directions per prime. A proved full-Iwahori variant or a source-compatible parabolic action is required; no identification of these distinct parameter families is assumed.

BLGG obtains the auxiliary scalar map from the determinant of its universal deformation (pp. 18-19). This must not be silently identified with the current fixed-determinant rational deformation problem: in the parabolic local model, an unramified complementary block and fixed unramified determinant would force the remaining inertia character to be trivial. Use the actual polarized/CM deformation problem or fully prove the alternative full-Iwahori fixed-determinant route.
provedPreliminaryBoundary: The currently constructed rational enlarged-support fixed-determinant rings and their full torus character algebras are preliminary arithmetic objects. They are not identified with the source unitary-group Hecke deformation family. Generic parameter convergence and quotient-module transfers do not construct that missing identification.
nativeReuseReview: Reviewed native adelic normalized/spherical Hecke and primitive eigenfunction modules. They prove complex Hecke action and eigenvalue facts, not finite freeness of the required integral unitary-group auxiliary modules. No native polarized deformation realization was found by the targeted production-source search. Pinned Mathlib Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing already gives finite projective-module freeness over a local coefficient ring; reuse it for the genuine Hecke summand instead of reproving projective-module freeness. Mathlib DoubleCoset.Quotient and the group-action orbit/stabilizer equivalences are the existing foundations for CHT Lemma 3.3.1.
sequencing: Finish and audit the bounded coefficient-action increment. Defer further rational-family wrappers. Next arithmetic expansion must address the source unitary/CM module construction or a documented rigorous alternative satisfying the same full continuation contract.
